person_note: The controlling narration is third person. The input's clearest scene quote narrates several characters externally, and the authorized publisher excerpt independently sustains third-person narration centered on Father Tim. The whole-book POV description confirms third person with shifts among several character perspectives, which are changes in focalization rather than changes of grammatical person. First-person material in the quote set consists of dialogue, prayer, devotional counsel, testimony, or imagined speech; notably, fuller context places q02117 inside the remembered words of the protagonist's mother. The remaining uncertainty is limited to the exact local speakers of some clipped first-person quotations and does not undermine the independently documented base structure.
